name: caveman-stats
description: Caveman mode lifecycle hooks: PostToolUse updates .caveman-statusline-suffix with token savings estimate; PreCompact re-injects caveman ruleset so mode survives context compaction.
//: PostToolUse is async (fire-and-forget, 3s timeout) — watermark-based so it reads only new JSONL bytes per tool call. PreCompact is synchronous (5s) — output injected into compaction summary. No SessionStart hook here; caveman activation is handled by the caveman@caveman marketplace plugin's own SessionStart.
